title: Detailed taco
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <path d="M22 58 Q22 28 50 24 Q78 28 78 58 L78 66 Q50 74 22 66 Z" fill="#D4921F"/>

  <path d="M15 60 Q15 50 25 42 Q20 52 25 65 L15 70 Z" fill="#F0C050"/>

  <path d="M85 60 Q85 50 75 42 Q80 52 75 65 L85 70 Z" fill="#F0C050"/>
  
  <!-- Filling visible at top - lettuce (green) -->
  <path d="M25 38 Q30 28 38 32 Q42 24 50 28 Q56 22 62 30 Q68 26 72 34 Q76 28 78 38 Q72 44 50 46 Q30 44 25 38 Z" fill="#4CAF50"/>

  <path d="M60 30 Q65 28 70 34" stroke="#66BB6A" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  
  <!-- Meat (brown) -->
  <path d="M28 42 Q35 38 48 40 Q58 36 70 42 Q74 46 50 50 Q30 48 28 42 Z" fill="#8B4513"/>

  <circle cx="36" cy="40" r="1.5" fill="#FF6B6B"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="38" r="2.5" fill="#E53935"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="38" r="1.2" fill="#FF6B6B"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="42" r="2" fill="#E53935"/>
  
  <!-- Cheese (yellow) -->
  <path d="M30 46 Q40 42 50 45 Q60 42 70 46 Q60 52 50 50 Q40 52 30 46 Z" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <path d="M35 47 Q42 45 48 47" stroke="#FFC107" stroke-width="1" fill="none"/>

  <path d="M40 34 Q44 30 48 34 Q52 38 56 34" stroke="#FFF8E1" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M48 36 Q52 32 58 36" stroke="#FFF8E1" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Guacamole (darker green) -->
  <path d="M42 30 Q46 27 50 30 Q54 27 58 30 Q56 34 50 33 Q44 34 42 30 Z" fill="#2E7D32"/>
  
  <!-- Shell bottom fold detail -->
  <path d="M25 65 Q50 72 75 65" stroke="#C8861A" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M28 68 Q50 74 72 68" stroke="#C8861A" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  
  <!-- Shell texture dots -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="55" r="1.5" fill="#D4921F"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="58" r="1.5" fill="#D4921F"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="57" r="1.5" fill="#D4921F"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="54" r="1.5" fill="#D4921F"/>
  
  <!-- Little cute face on taco! (optional cute detail) -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="42" r="1.5" fill="#3E2723"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="42" r="1.5" fill="#3E2723"/>
  <path d="M47 46 Q50 49 53 46" stroke="#3E2723" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
